scope: Mechanical harness compatibility only; no sample, item order, prompt, payload, logical output contract, model parameter, sealed reference, scorer or gate changed.

incidents.symptom: OpenAI response-format rejected item-level allOf in attempt 1 and claim.oneOf in attempt 2, both before inference.
incidents.resolution: For Codex only, mechanically derive a response-format schema by dropping the unsupported allOf and expressing the same claim nullability as type=[object,null], the nullable form documented by OpenAI Structured Outputs. The canonical schema, prompt, and strict local verdict/claim correlation validation remain unchanged.
incidents.resample: One identical prompt/payload/model request is required because attempt 1 produced no model response.

incidents.symptom: GLM produced complete 36-item JSON content in reversible envelope variants: an outer Markdown json code fence, legacy items/result aliases, the revisions array directly at the top level, a no-op description=placeholder field, or a redundant id identical to revision_id.
incidents.resolution: Strip one outer JSON code fence, mechanically map items to revisions and result to verdict when present, wrap a direct top-level array as revisions, drop only an exact description=placeholder no-op field, and drop id only when byte-identical to revision_id, then apply the unchanged strict validator. Reuse each successful raw envelope; do not resample.

incidents.symptom: The scorer's unexpected-candidate guard also matched preserved *-unparsed-attempt1.json parser-source copies.
incidents.resolution: Exclude only the exact -unparsed-attempt1.json suffix from candidate discovery; candidate identity, parsing, atom matching and gates are unchanged.
